messages:
Rina Gupta: Pushed a compact dark-theme mock for the Insights page. Main asks: make small legend chips readable at 12px, improve inline code contrast in the sidebar, and consider patterned lines for accessibility. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcde

Evan Park: Quick scan 1: legend text at 12px on #0b0f13 is borderline. Recommend increasing to 13px or raising contrast. Also the yellow series blends into the background at small widths.

Noah Brooks: For inline code in the sidebar, the current bg uses rgba(255,255,255,0.02) which flattens tokens. Suggest inner stroke: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04) and string token #ffcf85.

Ava Kim: Love the patterned-lines idea. For users with color vision deficiency, dashed or dot patterns plus marker shapes on points help a lot. We should add a toggle for "high-contrast lines" in user prefs.

Evan Park: Proposed compact palette that hits 4.5:1 on dark bg: blue #49a8ff, warm #ffb879, magenta #d08cff, mint #7ef0c7. Also set legend-label token to #e9f4ff.

ContrastBot: Automated results: current yellow vs bg => 2.7:1 (FAIL). proposed warm (#ffb879) vs bg => 5.3:1 (PASS). legend-label vs bg => 6.8:1 (PASS). focus indicator missing for legend toggles 1 (FAIL).

Rina Gupta: I'll update the Figma tokens and add notes: 13px legend min, patterned-line variants, inline code stroke, and a11y toggle. Will open a small PR with theme JSON and CSS util for focus halo.

Noah Brooks: Tiny copy tweak: tooltip text should be "Toggle series visibility" not just "Toggle". Saves confusion for screen readers.

Ava Kim: Added dashed-line spec and marker set to the Figma file, left comments with token names.

Rina Gupta: Thanks everyone 1 tagging QA once PR is ready. Closing when green.
